notes: Second isnad («فذكرته لإبراهيم فحدثني إبراهيم عن أبي عبيدة...», «بمثله سواء») carries the same saying right after the first, so it is a second group; the head is written again (rule 4, example 3)
The speaker of «فذكرته لإبراهيم» is read as Shaqiq (the link the Al-A'mash names); Shaqiq's own route through Ibrahim is inferred from the text, flagged for review
Single saying; Zaynab speaks as the last link; the story that follows is inside her report, no further transmitter
